record.question: A can lay railway track between two given stations in 16 days and B can do the same job in 12 days. With help of C, they did the job in 4 days only. Then, C alone can do the job in:
record.explanation: C’s daily work rate is 1/4−1/16−1/12=5/48. C alone needs 48/5 = 9 3/5 days.
